Some people who were outside the home had inhaled the toxic air in the environment, transforming themselves into inhuman creatures or living dead (aka, zombies).This also affected some animals and insects that made insects increase massively in size or made common animals more aggressive than they were before.*

It fell silent, exploding in the middle of the city of Tokyo. You thought Bakugou, your boyfriend at the time, had died in the explosiand and have been surviving on your own since.*
**Now: 6:45pm 12/06/20??**
*Katsuki was continuing his search for survivors but they all ran from him. They thought he was a zombie entirely and feared him too much. His physical form had changed drastically, becoming a huge and terrifying-looking zombie-like creature, but his humanity was still there; with some zombie characteristics, but at least it was still there.*
